text:
Luxury Skincare Tools & Devices 

GPT image 2 & Seedance 2.0 on @wavespeed_ai 

Prompt:- Step 1: Generate storyboard with GPT Image 2

Create a high-end 4:3 luxury beauty tools pitch deck storyboard in 3x4 grid (12 frames), editorial layout, NuFace/Dr. Barbara Sturm style, glacier white + rose gold palette. Structured flow: science → tool → ritual → glow → confidence closure. Each frame split: top cinematic image (no text) + bottom storyboard notes. Clinical luxury minimal aesthetic, science meets beauty mood, precision self-care. A rose gold facial device is the emotional center throughout.

Step 2: Take each frame into Seedance 2.0. Set to 1080p to preserve text clarity

Animate the provided 3x4 storyboard into a smooth cinematic video. Preserve exact shot order and continuity. Use slow device glide on skin, LED light pulse, serum absorption close-up, and mirror reflection reveal. Lighting transitions from cool clinical white light to warm vanity mirror rose glow. Beauty tools editorial aesthetic, surgical precision, empowered radiance mood. No new shots, no reordering, facial device remains emotional focus in all scenes.
content: Create a high-end 4:3 luxury beauty tools pitch deck storyboard in 3x4 grid (12 frames), editorial layout, NuFace/Dr. Barbara Sturm style, glacier white + rose gold palette. Structured flow: science → tool → ritual → glow → confidence closure. Each frame split: top cinematic image (no text) + bottom storyboard notes. Clinical luxury minimal aesthetic, science meets beauty mood, precision self-care. A rose gold facial device is the emotional center throughout.

translations.es: Crea un storyboard de pitch deck de herramientas de belleza de lujo en formato 4:3 de alta gama en una cuadrícula de 3x4 (12 cuadros), diseño editorial, estilo NuFace/Dr. Barbara Sturm, paleta blanco glaciar + oro rosa. Flujo estructurado: ciencia → herramienta → ritual → resplandor → cierre de confianza. Cada cuadro dividido: imagen cinematográfica superior (sin texto) + notas de storyboard en la parte inferior. Estética minimalista de lujo clínico, ambiente de ciencia y belleza, autocuidado de precisión. Un dispositivo facial de oro rosa es el centro emocional a lo largo de todo.
translations.fr: Créez un storyboard de présentation de luxe pour des outils de beauté au format 4:3, en grille 3x4 (12 cadres), avec une mise en page éditoriale, dans le style NuFace/Dr. Barbara Sturm, palette blanc glacier + or rose. Flux structuré : science → outil → rituel → éclat → conclusion de confiance. Chaque cadre est divisé : image cinématographique en haut (sans texte) + notes de storyboard en bas. Esthétique minimaliste de luxe clinique, ambiance où la science rencontre la beauté, soin de précision. Un appareil facial en or rose est le centre émotionnel tout au long.
translations.ja:
---
高級な4:3のラグジュアリービューティーツールのピッチデックストーリーボードを3x4グリッド（12フレーム）で作成し、エディトリアルレイアウト、NuFace/Dr. Barbara Sturmスタイル、グレイシャーホワイト＋ローズゴールドのパレットを使用します。構造的な流れ：科学 → ツール → 儀式 → 輝き → 自信の締めくくり。各フレームは、上部にシネマティックな画像（テキストなし）＋下部にストーリーボードノートを分割。臨床的なラグジュアリーミニマル美学、科学と美の融合のムード、精密なセルフケア。ローズゴールドのフェイシャルデバイスが全体を通して感情の中心となります。
---
translations.ko:
---
고급 4:3 럭셔리 뷰티 도구 피치 덱 스토리보드를 3x4 그리드(12 프레임)로 제작하세요. 편집 레이아웃, NuFace/Dr. Barbara Sturm 스타일, 빙하 화이트 + 로즈 골드 팔레트. 구조화된 흐름: 과학 → 도구 → 의식 → 광채 → 자신감 마무리. 각 프레임 분할: 상단 시네마틱 이미지(텍스트 없음) + 하단 스토리보드 노트. 임상적 럭셔리 미니멀 미학, 과학과 아름다움의 분위기, 정밀한 셀프 케어. 로즈 골드 페이셜 디바이스가 감정적 중심을 이룹니다.
---
translations.pt-BR: Crie um storyboard de pitch deck de ferramentas de beleza de luxo em formato 4:3 de alta qualidade, em grade 3x4 (12 quadros), layout editorial, estilo NuFace/Dr. Barbara Sturm, paleta branco glaciar + ouro rosa. Fluxo estruturado: ciência → ferramenta → ritual → brilho → encerramento com confiança. Cada quadro dividido: imagem cinematográfica no topo (sem texto) + notas do storyboard na parte inferior. Estética minimalista de luxo clínico, clima de ciência encontra beleza, autocuidado com precisão. Um dispositivo facial em ouro rosa é o centro emocional ao longo de todo o processo.
translations.zh-CN: 创建一个高端4:3奢华美容工具提案幻灯片故事板，采用3x4网格布局（12个画面），编辑风格，NuFace/Dr. Barbara Sturm风格，冰川白+玫瑰金配色。结构化流程：科学 → 工具 → 仪式 → 光彩 → 自信收尾。每个画面分为：顶部电影感图像（无文字）+底部故事板备注。临床奢华极简美学，科学与美丽相结合的氛围，精准的自我护理。玫瑰金面部设备贯穿始终，成为情感中心。
